name: tips_demo
data: synthetic (labelled generator rows, not real people)
note: Demo of tip and diff output; never claimed as accuracy [A29].

config.after: same scenario and seed with n_block: 0
config.walkway_rule: lingerer = speed < 0.3 m/s for >= 5 s; shelf_front lingerer -> BROWSE; walkway lingerer with >= 2 other moving tracks within 2 m during its stay -> BLOCK candidate; else unflagged
config.deadzone_rule: UNSEEN if (births+deaths)/visitors > 0.25; else DEAD iff Poisson-low vs 5x5 neighbour median (BH-FDR 0.05) AND visitors < 0.25 x that median; DEAD not dead in previous session -> WATCH
